```{r functions}
# =========================
# 1) Gaussian (RBF) kernel
# =========================
rbf_kernel <- function(X, sigma = NULL) {
  # X: numeric vector (length n) or numeric matrix (n x d)
  if (is.vector(X)) X <- matrix(X, ncol = 1)
  X <- as.matrix(X)
  n <- nrow(X)

  # sigma = std of input variable (as you requested)
  if (is.null(sigma)) {
    sigma <- stats::sd(as.vector(X))
  }
  if (!is.finite(sigma) || sigma <= 0) {
    stop("sigma is not positive/finite. (sd of input is 0?)")
  }

  # pairwise squared Euclidean distances: D_ij = ||x_i - x_j||^2
  # Use: ||a-b||^2 = ||a||^2 + ||b||^2 - 2 a^T b
  sq_norm <- rowSums(X * X)                    # length n
  G <- X %*% t(X)                              # Gram
  D <- outer(sq_norm, sq_norm, "+") - 2 * G    # n x n

  # numerical guard: distances should be >= 0
  D[D < 0] <- 0

  K <- exp(-D / (2 * sigma^2))
  return(K)
}

# =========================
# 2) Centering: HKH without explicitly forming H
#    HKH = K - rowMeans(K) - colMeans(K) + mean(K)
# =========================
center_kernel <- function(K) {
  K <- as.matrix(K)
  rm <- rowMeans(K)
  cm <- colMeans(K)
  mu <- mean(K)
  Kc <- K - rm - matrix(cm, nrow = nrow(K), ncol = ncol(K), byrow = TRUE) + mu
  return(Kc)
}

# =========================
# 3) HSIC0(K, L) = tr(K H L H) / (n-1)^2
#    using centered kernels: tr((HKH)(HLH)) = sum(Kc * Lc)  (for symmetric)
# =========================
hsic0 <- function(K, L) {
  K <- as.matrix(K); L <- as.matrix(L)
  if (nrow(K) != ncol(K) || nrow(L) != ncol(L) || nrow(K) != nrow(L)) {
    stop("K and L must be square and have the same size.")
  }
  n <- nrow(K)
  if (n < 2) stop("Need n >= 2.")

  Kc <- center_kernel(K)
  Lc <- center_kernel(L)

  hs <- sum(Kc * Lc) / ( (n - 1)^2 )
  return(hs)
}

# =========================
# 4) CKA(K, L) = HSIC(K, L) / sqrt( HSIC(K,K) * HSIC(L,L) )
#    Here HSIC = HSIC0 above
# =========================
cka_from_kernels <- function(K, L, eps = 1e-12) {
  a <- hsic0(K, L)
  b <- hsic0(K, K)
  c <- hsic0(L, L)
  #denom <- sqrt(max(b, 0) * max(c, 0)) + eps
  return(a / sqrt(b * c))
}

# =========================
# 5) Convenience: CKA directly from canonical variables (X, Y)
#    sigmaX = sd(X), sigmaY = sd(Y) by default
# =========================
cka_rbf <- function(X, Y, sigmaX = NULL, sigmaY = NULL, eps = 1e-12) {
  if (is.vector(X)) X <- matrix(X, ncol = 1)
  if (is.vector(Y)) Y <- matrix(Y, ncol = 1)
  X <- as.matrix(X); Y <- as.matrix(Y)

  if (nrow(X) != nrow(Y)) stop("X and Y must have the same number of rows (samples).")

  K <- rbf_kernel(X, sigma = sigmaX)  # sigmaX defaults to sd(X)
  L <- rbf_kernel(Y, sigma = sigmaY)  # sigmaY defaults to sd(Y)

  cka_from_kernels(K, L, eps = eps)
}

compute_SAKGCCA_canon <- function(Ktilde_list, alpha_list, scale = TRUE) {
  K <- length(Ktilde_list)
  if (length(alpha_list) != K) {
    stop("Ktilde_list 和 alpha_list 的长度(K个视图)不一致")
  }
  
  canon_list <- vector("list", K)   
  
  for (k in seq_len(K)) {
    Kk  <- Ktilde_list[[k]]   # list of length p_k
    alk <- alpha_list[[k]]    # list of length p_k
    pk  <- length(Kk)
    if (length(alk) != pk) {
      stop(sprintf("第 %d 个 view 的 Ktilde 和 alpha 变量数不一致", k))
    }
    
    n <- nrow(Kk[[1]])
    
    comp_list <- vector("list", pk)
    for (j in seq_len(pk)) {
      Kj <- Kk[[j]]      # n x n
      aj <- alk[[j]]     # n / n x R
      

      if (is.vector(aj)) {
        aj <- matrix(aj, ncol = 1)
      }
      comp_list[[j]] <- Kj %*% aj  # n x R
    }
    
    # sum_j Ktilde_{kj} %*% alpha_{kj}
    Fk <- Reduce("+", comp_list)   # n x R
    
    if (scale) {
      Fk <- Fk / sqrt(n)        
    }
    
    canon_list[[k]] <- Fk   
  }
  
  canon_list
}



gaussian_kernel_univariate <- function(x, sigma = NULL) {
  n <- length(x)
  dmat <- as.matrix(dist(x))
  if (is.null(sigma)) {
    d_vec <- dmat[upper.tri(dmat)]
    d_vec <- d_vec[d_vec > 0]
    if (length(d_vec) == 0) {
      sigma <- 1
    } else {
      sigma <- median(d_vec)
    }
  }
  if (sigma <= 0) sigma <- 1
  K <- exp(- (dmat^2) / (2 * sigma^2))
  return(K)
}

combine_kernel_from_X_u <- function(Xk, uk) {
  n  <- nrow(Xk)
  pk <- ncol(Xk)
  stopifnot(length(uk) == pk)
  
  Ktilde <- matrix(0, n, n)
  for (j in seq_len(pk)) {
    if (uk[j] == 0) next
    Kj <- gaussian_kernel_univariate(Xk[, j])
    Ktilde <- Ktilde + uk[j] * Kj
  }
  return(Ktilde)
}
```
